- $ A(t) = 4\pi r(t)^2 $ be the surface area of the sphere at time $ t $

$$
\frac{dV}{dt} = -k \cdot A(t) = -k \cdot 4\pi r(t)^2
$$

But from the chain rule:

$$
\frac{dV}{dt} = \frac{d}{dt} \left( \frac{4}{3} \pi r^3 \right) = 4\pi r^2 \frac{dr}{dt}
$$
